title: Hackathon Open Data 2026
registrationNote: Organizer call: applications before 16:30 local time on 20 November. Exact cutoff converted using Africa/Casablanca; the official form may restrict automated access.

moroccoEligibility.note: Article 2 invites qualifying adults in academia, startups, civil society and administration; the event is in Rabat.

en.text: Build with public data at ENSIAS in Rabat. Applications close on 20 November; the on-site hackathon takes place on 21–22 December.

fr.text: Créez des solutions avec les données publiques à l’ENSIAS, à Rabat. Candidatures jusqu’au 20 novembre ; hackathon sur place les 21 et 22 décembre.

ar.text: طوّروا حلولاً بالبيانات العمومية في المدرسة الوطنية العليا للمعلوميات وتحليل النظم بالرباط. آخر أجل للترشح 20 نونبر، والهاكاثون حضوري يومي 21 و22 دجنبر.

title: Infer-a-thon with Superlinked
registrationNote: Organizer states registration is open until 5 December. The Luma registration page invites registration. No exact cutoff time or time zone is given.

moroccoEligibility.note: Official organizer and Luma event explicitly welcome participants worldwide with no location restriction. Teams of 1–4; each person registers individually.

stages.name: Building phase
stages.registrationNote: Organizer states registration is open until 5 December; exact time and zone are not given.

moroccoEligibility.note: Official Luma eligibility section explicitly permits participation from anywhere in the world.
Top five teams per track qualify; official participation has no location restriction.

en.text: An online AI hackathon open worldwide. Build on 5–11 December; shortlisted teams present in the final on 20 December. Register individually, including team members.

fr.text: Un hackathon IA en ligne ouvert au monde entier. Construction du 5 au 11 décembre, puis finale le 20 décembre pour les équipes sélectionnées. Chaque membre doit s’inscrire.

ar.text: هاكاثون للذكاء الاصطناعي عبر الإنترنت مفتوح للمشاركين من جميع البلدان. البناء من 5 إلى 11 دجنبر، والنهائي للفرق المتأهلة يوم 20 دجنبر. التسجيل فردي لكل عضو.

title: Datathon Data-Territoires 2026
registrationNote: Official calendar closes candidatures on 30 October. Project delivery on 4 December is not a registration extension.

moroccoEligibility.note: Restricted to master, engineering and doctoral students at the listed FST/ENSA in Tanger, Tétouan and Al Hoceima, INSEA and ESI. Check the official institutional criteria.

en.text: A territorial-data competition for students at the institutions listed by the HCP. Applications are closed; project delivery is due on 4 December.

fr.text: Un datathon territorial destiné aux étudiants des établissements cités par le HCP. Les candidatures sont closes ; les livrables sont attendus le 4 décembre.

ar.text: مسابقة في البيانات الترابية لطلبة المؤسسات المحددة من المندوبية السامية للتخطيط. انتهى أجل الترشيح، وآخر أجل لتسليم المشاريع هو 4 دجنبر.
